label: #Outdoor Portrait   #BFF Style
description: The warm backlight of the evening is the most wonderful part of this picture, plus the expression from the eye lights the whole picture up. Setting an unusual story in an ordinary scene outperforms than the direct composition.
author: YI Technology

label: #Outdoor Portrait   #BFF Style
description: The core referance value of this photo is it centers the main point of the picture to the girl's face, bright light makes her face become the brightest part of the whole picture, plus the happy face makes the whole picture have a sense of presence. The girl's face lies in the golden section of the point, only taking half the body of the other girl into picture is a common composition method.
author: YI Technology

label: #Outdoor Portrait   #BFF Style
description: They don't have to be standing together to take a photo of best friends, you can always make a good one with the environment and props. Like the dessert showing in the picture. This looks more natural and arouses the resonance of audiences easily.
author: YI Technology

label: #Outdoor Portrait   #BFF Style
description: This is a local close-up portrait by using macro function of YI 42.5mm f/1.8 lens. During the portrait shooting, we should try a richer landscape composition. As the depth of field under macro mode is very shallow, so we need to ensure that the eye from each girl are at the same level, you can expand the depth of field to make sure the portrait is clearer, by lowering the aperture.
author: YI Technology

label: #Outdoor Portrait   #BFF Style
description:
This is a seven portion composition picture, both stand beside of the camera, the leg and the arm next to it keeps the same position, the other hand's action is slightly different, and one of the girls doesn't look at the lens, this adjustment gives the picture a certain sense of liveliness. 

On the right side of the camera we use the reflector to direct the light to the girl's face and under the neck.
author: YI Technology

label: #Outdoor Portrait   #BFF Style
description: The tone for best friends should be bright and clean, choose a diagonal distributed two-color wall as the background. The light-colored clothing and background together create a high-profile picture. Usually a shot of the upper body can easily appear awkward, so use a intimate hand gesture to make the picture natural, warm and friendly.
author: YI Technology

label: #Outdoor Portrait   #Brotherhood
description: Try black and white tone if you wear dark clothes, it makes the pictures even more clean if there isn't too much color. Two people lie against the side of the tree to compose a triangle. Doesn't the two trees in the background remind you of the YI logo? Add fun flair in your picture whenever possible.
author: YI Technology

label: #Outdoor Portrait   #Brotherhood
description: This is another way to express your picture in a combination of crisp and blurriness which is composing with the environment. As the light of evening is soft, the transition from dark to light is natural, the main body of the face will be placed in the shadow position to get a soft facial tone when shooting, notice that the two are not the same standing, in real shot we can let the person out of the depth of field exaggerate the body movements even more to make the picture more interesting.
author: YI Technology

label: #Outdoor Portrait   #Brotherhood
description: During the sunset choose the backlight as the main light source while in the front choose the reflector to compensate the light to the portrait face. The combination of light,  shape and the front highlights the portrait. With one standing and one sat down, one poses sideways and one faces forward making the whole picture less dull, and more interesting.
author: YI Technology

label: #Outdoor Portrait   #Brotherhood
description:
This method expresses not only the brotherhood affection but also the manliness. We demand the absolute symmetrically, the same outfit, gesture and also expressions. 

This applies broadly. We choose black and white tone to focus only on the person themselves.
author: YI Technology

label: #Outdoor Portrait   #Brotherhood
description:
This method enables you to take potrait pictures in a combination of crisp and blurry way. Two people stand in a vertical position, focuse on one of them with big aperture, the other one will be blurred automatically. 

Both looking directly to the camera to reach an effect of with same spirit in different position. This method applies to those scenario with deep background.
author: YI Technology

label: #Outdoor Portrait   #Brotherhood
description:
With outfits in similar style and a blank white wall as the background, the picture will be a attention grabber to begin with. The two stand with their same side facing the camera, with same gestures and looking directly into the lens, this style can be repetitively used in many scenarios. 

It makes the boys bright and handsome.  A reflector is needed to fill the lights and decrease the shadows around the eyes and nose.
author: YI Technology

label: #Outdoor Portrait
description: A pair of beautiful eyes could make the difference. Whether it be a caring gesture or loving glance, they can all express the beauty of love. Sometimes, an extreme close-up works better than regular composition. Hold her hand under silhouette light, a mixture between the two, the long and last moment will be memorized forever.
author: YI Technology

label: #Outdoor Portrait   #Silhouette Portrait
description: When you're in a wide-open area with the light hitting against the direction of the lens, you're in for a very nice silhouette picture. Silhouette pictures often feature a very conservative and "shy" feeling, hence grabs the viewers eyes more easily. First you need to make sure that the outline of the main subject is clean, then the gestures and poses need to carry a core message. The focal point should be on the border of the main subject's outline and the background.
author: YI Technology

label: #Indoor Portrait
description: When the background is made of interesting but flat components, a tilting angle shooting up might be a good option. Let the hand holding couple lean their bodies slightly toward the camera, the picture will appear to be more lively. Use a wide angle lens to shoot at a close distance, the distortion will make pictures show more depth. Again, a reflector highlighting the bottom half of the protagonists' face will make them pop up even more.
author: YI Technology

label: #Indoor Portrait
description: Utilize the railings to emphasize the main protagonist, and use the light reflection from the glass as filler light. These two tricks are very common in photo composition and lighting. Conversation is one of the ways for couples to act natural. The photographer just has to snap at the right moment. Avoid shooting directly to the eyes to create a more dynamic story.
author: YI Technology

label: #Indoor Portrait
description: The theme of a couple of lovers should be warm,  sweet, lively, and lovely. The image of the two looking at each other into the eyes, making the theme more vivid. With backlight highlighting the shape of one's facial features and a reflector lighting up the face, the transition from darkness to brightness will emphasize the mood of the photo.
author: YI Technology

label: #Outdoor Portrait
description: With the ambience of a romantic café and some cute gestures, a love story can be easily achieved. The man who looks into the lens needs to be lively, perhaps a smile. If possible, fill up some lights from the side with a reflector. Background and the desk will compose a stable triangle, which allows the attention to be focused on the human subject.
author: YI Technology

label: #Outdoor Portrait   #Street Snap
description:
Pick a location where there are rows of tables for your background. The repeating pattern will provide more depth for the image.

Let your model sit sideways on the edge of the table and face the camera.

Her hands can be placed either on her legs or on the table.
author: YI Technology

label: #Outdoor Portrait   #Street Snap
description:
This accentuates the curves of your model’s body. To do this, let your model turn her back and leave one side of her face towards the camera.

Facing towards the railing, let her hands rest comfortably and relaxed on the handrail. Provide space to where the model is facing.
author: YI Technology

label: #Outdoor Portrait   #Street Snap
description:
Find a desk and allow your model to rest both hands on it. One hand should hold the head by supporting the chin and the other hand with a small prop and this can be a medium sized object like an apple or a cup. 

Ask your model to smile and face the camera without looking at it.
author: YI Technology

label: #Indoor Portrait
description:
Let your model wear clothes having the same shade as the background. Have her sit comfortable and relaxed on a couch or chair. 

Make sure all her body joints do not point directly to the camera by bending arms and legs while holding a throw pillow. 

Make sure her hands and feet appear in the frame to make it look natural.
author: YI Technology

label: #Campus Portrait
description:
Let your model stand with one leg and the other bent creating a triangle. Hands can rest naturally at the side.

Find a spot where light strikes the face and the body under the shade to highlight the face
author: YI Technology

label: #Outdoor Portrait   #Street Snap
description:
This features the curves of a model’s body. Let your model lean back and allow both her elbows rest on the railing. One arm extends to one side and the other clipped.

Allow your model to face the direction where the extended arm is and refrain model from smiling to give that elegant feel.
author: YI Technology

label: #Outdoor Portrait   #Street Snap
description:
Position your model near a reflective glass or mirror. Find an angle where you have the vantage point of capturing both model and reflection.

Let her stand sideways and highlighting the contours of her body. Leave both hands straight-down and relaxed with one foot forward.
author: YI Technology

label: #Outdoor Portrait
description:
The repeating lines from stairs will compliment your subject’s figure and form. Placing your model in the center will highlight this aspect.

Let your model sit sideways with one leg bent and the other extended. Her hands should rest naturally on her thighs.
author: YI Technology

label: #Outdoor Portrait
description:
Let your model lay sideways on the grass emphasizing the curvatures of her body by placing one hand in front of her face ensuring her hips are not blocked from the view. 

Place the camera on the grass at ground level. Focus on the model leaving the foreground and background out of focus giving importance to the subject.
author: YI Technology
